key.name: custom-icon-path
key.description: Path to an image (SVG/PNG) to use as the logo. Leave empty to detect the distribution logo automatically from /etc/os-release and the icon theme.

key.name: symbolic-icon
key.description: Prefer a monochrome (-symbolic) variant of the distribution logo, which follows the top bar's text colour. Ignored when a custom logo file is set.

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Size of the logo. 0 matches the top bar's font size (1em), as in Red Hat's patch.

key.name: show-workspace-dots
key.description: Keep GNOME's workspace indicator dots next to the logo.

key.name: show-label
key.description: Show the text "Activities" next to the logo, as the button looked before GNOME 45 (and in Red Hat's original patch).
